newsitem.title: USA: Central Garden acquires stake in lawn co.
newsitem.headline: Central Garden acquires stake in lawn co.

text.p: Central Garden & Pet Co said it acquired Commerce, a distributor of lawn and garden products based in Baltimore.

Central Garden said Commerce has distribution centers in Baltimore and Providence, Rhode Island, and serves customers in the middle Atlantic and New England markets. Commerce has annual sales of about $110 million.
Central Garden said the acquisition will strengthen its presence in the lawn and garden business on the East coast.
Central Garden, a leading national distributor of lawn, garden and pet supply products, and a major national distributor of pool supplies, gained 1-11/16 to 21-5/8.
